objective: Evaluate patient- and event-level concordance for medications and measurement/observation semantics in the frozen OMOP build without changing ETL mappings based on observed disagreement.

patient_linkage.rule: Use the exact source-derived patient linkage established by the frozen ETL Person transformation.

drug.semantic_reference: Frozen etl_drug_event_route nonzero Standard Drug targets.
drug.mapped_denominator: Only nonzero Standard Drug targets from the frozen drug route ledger enter mapped semantic concordance denominators.
drug.unresolved_rule: target_concept_id=0 rows are reported separately as unresolved coverage and are excluded from mapped semantic match percentages.
drug.one_to_many_rule: Distinct valid Standard Drug targets are preserved as distinct semantic routes and compared as multisets rather than collapsed.
drug.route_rule: Route concept agreement is a secondary characterization metric because a large explicit route-concept-zero population remains under the frozen source-derived policy; absence of an exact Route mapping must not invalidate otherwise matched Drug semantics.
drug.quantity_days_supply_rule: Quantity, days supply, dose, and route-related fields are descriptive secondary comparisons only where source semantics and units are directly comparable; they are not primary event identity keys.
secondary_attribution: unresolved concept-zero by source family and mapping basis

measurement_observation.semantic_reference: Frozen vocabulary-driven LOINC/UCUM mappings plus frozen route ledgers for OBS_CLIN and cross-domain Procedure/Condition semantics.

value_analysis_layers.layer_1_semantic_presence: Compare mapped nonzero concept/domain event multisets independent of values or units.
value_analysis_layers.layer_2_numeric_value: For events with directly comparable numeric values, compare value_as_number using exact source-derived numeric conversion first and report absolute differences; no tolerance is introduced post hoc.
value_analysis_layers.layer_3_unit: Compare units only when source unit text resolves uniquely to an active Standard UCUM concept under the frozen case-sensitive mapping rule.
value_analysis_layers.layer_4_text_categorical: For categorical/text observations, compare mapped value concepts where a frozen exact Standard mapping exists; otherwise retain source text descriptively and report concept-zero separately.

measurement_observation.lab_rule: LAB_RESULT_CM rows with RESULT_DATE are eligible under the frozen transformation. LOINC events routed to Standard Measurement concepts are compared in Measurement; active Standard LOINC concepts in Observation are compared in Observation. Unresolved or ambiguous concepts remain concept zero and are reported separately.
measurement_observation.vital_rule: Numeric VITAL fields HT, WT, SYSTOLIC, DIASTOLIC, and ORIGINAL_BMI are expanded into prespecified LOINC Measurement semantics. Categorical SMOKING, TOBACCO, and TOBACCO_TYPE are Observation semantics under the frozen mappings.
measurement_observation.obs_clin_rule: Use the frozen etl_obs_clin_route target domain and target concept as the prespecified source-side semantic reference; concept-zero Observation routes are unresolved coverage and are not mapped semantic matches.
measurement_observation.obs_gen_rule: OBS_GEN has no validated Standard concept mapping in the frozen ETL and is therefore characterized as source-preserved Observation concept zero rather than forced into mapped semantic concordance.
measurement_observation.unit_rule: UCUM exact matching is case-sensitive using the frozen binary-collation policy. Unit concept zero is reported as unit coverage, not event-level semantic failure when the measurement concept/date/person match.
